title: Z: The End
description:
Z: The End is a survival game in a zombie-infested world. Your only goal is to survive.

The virus escaped containment, and the infected destroyed the world. Scavenge what is left, build a safe house, and find or craft weapons to fight off the zombies.

Features:• Casual Zombie Survival Sandbox that's meant to be easy to pick up and play.

• Single-player where you can save anytime, with cloud saves supported.

• Zombies that are slow but still dangerous.

• Find or harvest materials for building and crafting.

• Loot, hunt, or grow your own food to stay fed.

• Build a house of your own or reinforce an existing one to your liking.

• A moderately compact map that leaves room for exploration, without taking hours to traverse.

• Day turns to night, and Mother Nature continues to take its course.

• Weather that impacts the world. Rain and thunderstorms make the plants grow faster and reduce your visibility, while fog makes it even harder for the infected to see you.

• Walk with the infected by covering your scent with their guts.

• Find notes from survivors to see what happened to them and the world.
description_short: Z: The End is a top-down shooter survival sandbox set in a world infested with zombies. Explore, scavenge for supplies and weapons, and survive as long as you can against the zombies and the elements.
